description: This file defines a custom callback handler class for LiteLLM Proxy, including various asynchronous hooks for pre- and post-call processing, moderation, and streaming. It is intended to be used as a plugin or custom extension in the LiteLLM Proxy framework.

classes.name: MyCustomHandler
classes.description: A custom handler class inheriting from CustomLogger, implementing various asynchronous hooks for proxy call lifecycle events.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler instance.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Hook executed before an API call; can modify or inspect request data.

methods.name: async_post_call_failure_hook( self, request_data: dict, original_exception: Exception, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, traceback_str: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Hook executed after a call failure; can handle exceptions and logging.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Hook executed after a successful call; can process response data.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Hook called for moderation during API calls, possibly for content filtering.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response: str, )
methods.description: Hook called during streaming responses, for real-time handling.

ctags.name: async_moderation_hook
ctags.pattern: /^    async def async_moderation_hook(  # call made in parallel to llm api call$/
ctags.signature: ( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )

ctags.name: async_post_call_failure_hook
ctags.signature: ( self, request_data: dict, original_exception: Exception, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, traceback_str: Optional[str] = None, )

ctags.name: async_post_call_success_hook
ctags.signature: ( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )

ctags.name: async_pre_call_hook
ctags.signature: ( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
